newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran road crash kills 14, injures 13 - IRNA.
newsitem.headline: Iran road crash kills 14, injures 13 - IRNA.

text.p: Fourteen people were killed and 13 injured when a minibus and a trailer collided in northern Iran, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said on Tuesday.
The accident took place 65 km (40 miles) north of the town of Shahroud on Monday, IRNA said.
"Experts from the highway police department are investigating the cause of the accident," IRNA said.
